data.title: Income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, setting the income tax at €3,014.00 against €3,668.00 wage tax already withheld, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €654.00 to be transferred to the person's account.
data.explanation: This is your 2025 income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) from the Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig. Your tax was set at €3,014.00, and since €3,668.00 wage tax was already withheld from your salary, you are due a refund of €654.00, which the tax office will transfer to your bank account automatically — no action needed for that. If you believe the assessment is incorrect (for example about the work-related expenses or special expenses deducted), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline. No reason needs to be given, though one is recommended. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final.

remedy.form_text: Richten Sie den Einspruch schriftlich oder elektronisch an das Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig; Sie können ihn dort auch zu Protokoll geben.
remedy.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Deadline to object to the tax assessment (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the tax calculation, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the assessment becomes final and binding.
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Tax refund transfer
items.action: No action needed; the refund will be transferred automatically to the account on file.
items.quote: Das Guthaben von 654,00 € überweisen wir auf Ihr Konto DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18.
